user.title: Set up Pošta Slovenije
user.description: Sign in to your MojaPošta account to have its parcels found for you, or track parcels by their tracking code without an account.

account.title: Sign in to MojaPošta
account.description: Use the username and password of your MojaPošta account.

data_description.username: The username or e-mail address you sign in to MojaPošta with.
data_description.password: Your MojaPošta password. It is stored so the integration can sign in again when its session ends.

tracking.title: Track parcels by tracking code
tracking.description: Pošta Slovenije tracking needs no account or postal code — the hub is created right away. Add parcels afterwards via the integration options or the `posta_slovenije.track_parcel` service.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to MojaPošta again
reauth_confirm.description: MojaPošta no longer accepts the password for {account}. Enter the current one.

error.invalid_auth: MojaPošta did not accept this username and password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach MojaPošta. Try again later.

data_description.add: Enter a Pošta Slovenije tracking code (two letters, nine digits and two more letters, usually SI) to start tracking it. You find it on the shipping confirmation or the missed-delivery notice.

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update (timestamp, status, original text). Off by default.

incoming_parcels.title: Manage incoming parcels
incoming_parcels.description: Tracking codes for parcels you are expecting. Tracking by code cannot tell a parcel you sent from one you are receiving, so file each code in the list it belongs to.

outgoing_parcels.title: Manage outgoing parcels
outgoing_parcels.description: Tracking codes for parcels you sent. They are counted and reported separately, so they stay out of your incoming parcel count.

error.invalid_tracking_code: That is not a valid Pošta Slovenije tracking code: two letters, nine digits and two more letters, usually ending in SI. Check it for a typo — the ninth digit is a check digit over the eight before it. For example CH000000005SI.
error.already_tracked: That parcel is already being tracked.

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking a parcel by its Pošta Slovenije tracking code.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: Whether you are receiving this parcel or sending it. Tracking by code cannot tell the two apart. Calling this again with the other direction moves an already tracked parcel.

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Stop tracking a parcel by its Pošta Slovenije tracking code.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The Pošta Slovenije tracking code to stop tracking.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed
